def f(I):
    H_,W_=len(I),len(I[0])
    cs=comps(I)
    bycolor={}
    for col,c in cs: bycolor.setdefault(col,[]).append(c)
    O=[[0]*W_ for _ in range(H_)]
    for col,grps in bycolor.items():
        if len(grps)!=2: continue
        grps.sort(key=lambda c:min(y for y,x in c))
        upper,lower=grps
        oy=min(y for y,x in upper)
        h=max(y for y,x in lower)-min(y for y,x in lower)+1
        for y,x in upper: O[y][x]=col
        for y,x in lower:
            yy=h+(y-min(y for y,x in lower))-1  # place so bottom of shape at last row... careful
        # simpler: shift lower so its LAST row == H_-1
        base=max(y for y,x in lower)
        dy=(H_-1)-base
        for y,x in lower: O[y+dy][x]=col
    return O
for p in (1,2):
    P=f(G[f'Demo pair {p} input']); O=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    print('pair',p,'match:',P==O)

import numpy as np
def comp(g):
    g=np.array(g); h,w=g.shape
    seen=np.zeros((h,w),bool); res=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i,j]!=0 and not seen[i,j]:
                col=int(g[i,j]); st=[(i,j)]; seen[i,j]=True; cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x,y]==col and not seen[x,y]:

def f(gin):
    g=np.array(gin); H,W=g.shape
    ci=comps_of(gin)
    def is_ring(cells):
        hgt=max(a for a,b in cells)-min(a for a,b in cells)+1
        wid=max(b for a,b in cells)-min(b for a,b in cells)+1
        return len(cells)==2*(hgt+wid)-4
    rings=[(c,cells) for c,cells in ci if is_ring(cells)]
    others=[(c,cells) for c,cells in ci if not is_ring(cells)]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    occ=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    def slide(cells,step):
        cur=sorted(cells)
        while True:
            nxt=[(a+step,b) for a,b in cur]
            if all(0<=a<H and not occ[a][b] for a,b in nxt):
                cur=nxt
            else: break
        return cur
    # do sliding pass-by-pass to avoid collisions breaking; order within group by (col,row)
    res=[]
    for lst,keyfn,direc in [(rings,lambda t:(min(b for a,b in t[1]),min(a for a,b in t[1])),-1),
                             (others,lambda t:(min(b for a,b in t[1]),min(a for a,b in t[1])),+1)]:
        for c,cells in sorted(lst,key=keyfn):
            pl=slide(list(cells),direc)
            for a,b in pl: out[a][b]=c; occ[a][b]=True

def cc(g,bg=None):
    import collections
    if bg is None: bg=collections.Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; res=[]
    for a in range(H):
        for b in range(W):
            if g[a][b]!=bg and not seen[a][b]:
                col=g[a][b]; q=[(a,b)]; seen[a][b]=True; c_=[]
                while q:
                    x,y=q.pop(); c_.append((x,y))
                    for dx,dy in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=nx<H and 0<=ny<W and g[nx][ny]==col and not seen[nx][ny]:

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
